choices: All functions should be implemented in the network
A function should be implemented at the endpoints, and placed in the network only as a justifiable performance optimisation
Encryption belongs at the network layer
Reliability requires acknowledgements at every hop
explanation: Saltzer, Reed and Clark's 1981 paper. Reliable file transfer requires end-to-end verification regardless of what the network guarantees, since the disk or the application may fail — so the network's version is redundant for correctness and justified only if it makes things faster.
